he A-effect reverses with time, which suggests a positive A-dependent term added to a negative one.
- The most consistent ingredients were a 1/t term and terms in sqrt(t) or t^0.4–0.65 multiplying powers of A. A full linear basis reproduced the data to 3e-8, but no sparse subset came close to exact.
